I will produce a quantified probability that the United States wins the men's ice hockey gold medal at Milano Cortina 2026 (deciding game 2026-02-22). I will show the factors I considered, how I weighted them, and the numeric sub-probabilities that led to my final probability.

Step 1 — gather facts (search results)
- Team USA roster announced 2026-01-02; 25-man NHL-powered roster includes top stars (Auston Matthews, Jack Eichel, Quinn Hughes) and is largely the group that reached the 4 Nations Face‑Off final last winter. (Straits Times, 2026-01-02) [source: roster announcement article]
- NHL players are participating at Milano-Cortina 2026, bringing the best players back to the Olympics for the first time since 2014. (Straits Times, 2026-01-02) [source: NHL players return]
- Canada’s roster (announced 2025-12-31) is also NHL-powered and widely viewed as one of the early favorites (names like Connor McDavid, Crosby, MacKinnon noted in coverage). (Straits Times, 2025-12-31) [source: Canada roster article]
- Pre-tournament tournament form: the US beat most competition to reach the 4 Nations Face‑Off final but lost to Canada in OT; Canada won that event. (Straits Times coverage referencing 4 Nations Face‑Off) [source: articles summarizing 4 Nations Face‑Off]

These items establish: (a) the U.S. team is strong and contains top NHL stars; (b) Canada is also extremely strong and is widely considered a leading favorite; (c) NHL participation increases overall parity among top hockey
